note: Ledger files that predate the 2026-10-21 hypothesis-cycle gates. A record whose origin file is listed in legacy_files is validated against its own schema but is NOT required to carry the cycle fields (query_id on sources; round / derived_from_evidence_ids / refutation_condition / next_* on hypotheses; derived_from / searched_refutation on relations). Files in pre_split_files predate only the 2026-10-21 round-1 split of next_observations into next_literature_questions + next_internal_measurements; they keep every other check (round, derived_from, refutation). This is a file list rather than an ID list on purpose: shard files are immutable and written by one session, so a new file is exactly the set of new records, and no one has to maintain 250 IDs. Do not add a file here to silence a gate on new work -- add the missing field instead (docs/2026-10-21_hypothesis-cycle-automation.md section 5).
